attempts.userPrompt:
Write Mermaid diagram source for the following description:

Describe a request-authorization flowchart: An incoming request arrives at the edge. The
edge checks the client cert chain and forwards to a decision step labeled 'trusted zone |
2FA verified | mTLS pinned CA valid?'. If all three hold, route to Grant access; otherwise
route to Deny access and log 'reason: one or more of {zone, 2FA, mTLS} failed' with a note
that retries beyond 3 attempts trigger a lockout.
attempts.dslSource:
flowchart TD
    A[Incoming request] --> B[Check client cert chain]
    B --> C{trusted zone | 2FA verified | mTLS pinned CA valid?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Grant access]
    C -->|No| E[Deny access]
    E --> F[Log: reason: one or more of {zone, 2FA, mTLS} failed]
    F --> G[Note: retries beyond 3 attempts trigger a lockout]
